main.summary: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment append request.

property.name: ExpectedStateVersion
property.summary: Optional expected current transfer state version that, when supplied, must match before the segment is accepted.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Requested append payload length in bytes.

property.name: Offset
property.summary: Requested append offset which should equal the current durable appended length.

property.name: SegmentSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the payload carried by the envelope.

property.name: StreamSHA512
property.summary: Optional caller-declared final SHA-512 of the complete durable stream payload.

main.summary: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment append response.

property.name: AppendedLength
property.summary: Current durable appended length after processing the request.
